Senior Backend Engineer (5+ years) working on MISUMI Americas' AI-powered digital manufacturing platform, owning customer-facing and internal APIs plus overall system reliability. The work centers on Node.js and TypeScript services on AWS — SQS, Lambda, EC2, RDS — built as event-driven, distributed systems with REST and GraphQL interfaces over SQL and NoSQL stores. A distinguishing feature is that AI coding agents are expected throughout design, implementation, and testing, with the engineer responsible for specs, tests, and reviewing agent-generated code.
